one_liner: Open-source CRM with workspace-generated REST and GraphQL APIs, API keys, OAuth, and a built-in MCP server. Cloud API use needs a free trial or paid plan, and self-hosting is free.
auth_notes: API keys are Bearer tokens created in Settings → Developers → API. The API page also points to OAuth for external apps acting on behalf of users. The fetched pages do not describe OAuth flow details. Composio lists only API_KEY, which is why auth confidence is medium.
access_notes: The pricing page says to start a free trial without a credit card. The plans listed are Pro at $9 per user per month, Organization at $39 per user per month, and Enterprise. REST and GraphQL API and MCP server are marked Yes on all three. The docs also mention a Free plan on self-hosted instances, so self-hosting is a free path. The pages do not show whether the cloud trial has an API-key limit or how long it lasts.
blocker_notes: Cloud API use needs a free trial or a paid plan. Each workspace has its own schema, so setup is per customer. Self-hosting is a free path.

evidence.quote: Create an API key in **Settings → Developers → API → + Create key**. Copy it immediately — it’s shown once.
For OAuth-based access (external apps acting on behalf of users), see [OAuth](/developers/extend/oauth).
Start your free trial today without credit card.
On a self-hosted instance, the built-in providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, xAI) work on every plan, Free included.
**Core API** — `/rest/` and `/graphql/` CRUD on records: People, Companies, Opportunities, your custom objects.
